templates.name: Nodeguard by Zabbix agent
templates.description: nodeguard XDP firewall + Suricata IPS monitoring. Requires the nodeguard.kv UserParameter and sudoers rule from the nodeguard repo (etc/).

items.name: nodeguard kv raw
items.description: Master item: the whole nodeguard kv export in one agent poll. Every other item is dependent on it. Short history retention aids torn-parse debugging.

items.name: nodeguard attach state
items.description: attached, detached, or unknown (xdp-loader itself failed; the program may still be enforcing)

triggers.name: nodeguard XDP is not attached on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: detached = fail open (no enforcement); unknown = xdp-loader broken, state unverifiable

triggers.name: nodeguard telemetry stale on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: The watchdog export or the agent path is dead; nodeguard state unknown to monitoring.

items.name: nodeguard kill switch
items.description: nonzero = enforcement soft-off (latched)

triggers.name: nodeguard enforcement latched OFF on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: nodeguard-on to re-arm after diagnosing; check ng.latch for manual vs watchdog

items.name: nodeguard latch owner
items.description: manual, watchdog, or none

items.name: nodeguard active blocks
items.description: entries in the block maps

items.name: nodeguard wg port match
items.description: 1 = config[0] equals tailscaled's live port

triggers.name: nodeguard WireGuard port drift on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: watchdog rewrites within a minute; persistent drift means the watchdog timer is dead

items.name: suricata unit state
items.description: systemd is-active for suricata

triggers.name: suricata is not active on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: detection blind while down; zero traffic impact by design

items.name: nodeguard responder unit state
items.description: systemd is-active for nodeguard-responder

triggers.name: nodeguard responder is not active on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: no NEW blocks while down; existing blocks expire in-kernel

items.name: suricata kernel drops
items.description: cumulative af-packet kernel_drops across capture threads

triggers.name: suricata capture is dropping packets on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: ring saturated; reduced detection coverage. Raise ring-size or trim the ruleset

items.name: nodeguard XDP drop rate v4
items.description: blocked packets per second (in-kernel drops of blocklisted sources)

triggers.name: nodeguard v4 drop rate above weekly baseline on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: baselinedev(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[drop_v4],1h:now/h,"d",10)>3 and last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[drop_v4])>10
triggers.description: Seasonal baseline deviation with an absolute floor (baselinedev explodes on near-zero baselines). Imported at Information severity; promoted only after 14 days of reviewed-quiet trend rows.

triggers.name: nodeguard v4 drop rate above static ceiling on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Placeholder ceiling; value retuned from phase 5 shadow data (tasks.md 5.4). Backstop for slow ramps the baseline family cannot catch.

items.name: nodeguard XDP drop rate v6
items.description: IPv6 drops per second

triggers.name: nodeguard v6 drop rate above weekly baseline on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: baselinedev(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[drop_v6],1h:now/h,"d",10)>3 and last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[drop_v6])>10
triggers.description: Seasonal baseline deviation with an absolute floor (baselinedev explodes on near-zero baselines). Imported at Information severity; promoted only after 14 days of reviewed-quiet trend rows.

triggers.name: nodeguard v6 drop rate above static ceiling on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Placeholder ceiling; value retuned from phase 5 shadow data (tasks.md 5.4). Backstop for slow ramps the baseline family cannot catch.

items.name: nodeguard XDP pass rate
items.description: default-pass packets per second

items.name: nodeguard allowlist pass rate
items.description: allowlist hits per second

items.name: nodeguard WireGuard pass rate
items.description: WireGuard port passes per second

items.name: feeds enforce
items.description: 1 = FEEDS_ENFORCE=yes in the deployed config

items.name: feeds approved count
items.description: feeds recorded in approved.json

items.name: feeds config/approval mismatch
items.description: 1 = approvals exist but the deployed config does not enforce them (deploy-reverted config tripwire)

triggers.name: nodeguard feeds config/approval mismatch on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: A deploy likely reverted a live config edit; enforcement is decaying open. Re-align hosts/<host>/feeds.conf and redeploy.

items.name: feeds journal reset
items.description: 1 = state.json was lost and rebuilt insert-only this run

items.name: feeds churn held
items.description: 1 = a feed's composition jumped past the churn brake

triggers.name: nodeguard feed composition churn held on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Review last-diff.txt; accept with nodeguard-feeds apply --feed <id> --confirm.

items.name: feeds last run
items.description: epoch of the last run

triggers.name: nodeguard feeds have never run on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: feeds_last_run_ts has been 0 for 24h: a wiped /var/lib/nodeguard or a disabled feeds timer. Deliberately not gated on last()>0 so the never-ran state cannot read healthy forever.

items.name: feeds owned entries
items.description: journal-owned block entries

items.name: feeds candidates
items.description: candidates seen this run

items.name: feeds rejected
items.description: candidates dropped by protected/allow guards; nonzero is anomalous with bogon feeds excluded upstream

triggers.name: nodeguard feed shipped protected ranges on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: A curated feed is shipping protected or allowlisted ranges; review last-diff.txt.

items.name: feeds failed count
items.description: feeds FAILED this run (fetch, validation, staleness, canary)

triggers.name: nodeguard feeds failing for 18h on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Transient-failure carrier; per-feed staleness escalates separately.

items.name: feeds oldest success
items.description: min over configured feeds of the last successful exchange

triggers.name: nodeguard feed spamhaus_drop_v4 failed open on {HOST.NAME}

triggers.description: Entries for this feed have expired in-kernel; designed decay, not an outage.

items.name: feeds spamhaus_drop_v4 snapshot age
items.description: seconds since spamhaus_drop_v4's content last changed

triggers.name: nodeguard feed spamhaus_drop_v4 upstream frozen on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Upstream unchanged for 7 days; re-stamp hard-stops at 14 days.

items.name: feeds map errors
items.description: per-key bpftool failures this run (one lost key each, never a lost batch)

items.name: nodeguard kv timestamp
items.description: epoch stamped by the exporter at the top of the kv file

triggers.name: nodeguard telemetry clock skew or frozen kv on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: The kv timestamp is more than 5 minutes from server time: a frozen but still-served kv file or host clock skew. Complements the nodata trigger, which only catches the file not arriving at all.

items.name: nodeguard stats read failure
items.description: 1 = the stats pin exists but the dump or parse failed; the counter keys are omitted rather than served as zeros

items.name: nodeguard stats2 read failure
items.description: 1 = the stats2 pin exists but the dump or parse failed; the sanity counter keys are omitted rather than served as zeros

triggers.name: nodeguard stats2 unreadable on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: The stats2 pin exists but could not be read; sanity counters are unknown, not zero.

items.name: nodeguard expired pass rate
items.description: packets per second passed because their block entry had expired in-kernel

items.name: nodeguard non-IP pass rate
items.description: non-IP ethertype passes per second

items.name: nodeguard parse-fail pass rate
items.description: packets per second passed because the IP header failed bounds validation (fail-open by design)

items.name: nodeguard TCP SYN+FIN packets
items.description: SYN and FIN set together; classic scanner fingerprint, counted statelessly before any verdict (cumulative)

items.name: nodeguard TCP SYN+FIN rate
items.description: SYN and FIN set together; classic scanner fingerprint, counted statelessly before any verdict (per second)

triggers.name: nodeguard TCP SYN+FIN rate above static floor on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Generous static rate floor, the sanity counters' first alerting layer per design section 6; placeholder value retuned from phase 5 shadow data (tasks.md 5.4). A baselinedev variant is added only after a demonstrated quiet baseline.

items.name: suricata alerts
items.description: cumulative detect.alert count from the same suricatasc dump-counters call as kernel_drops

items.name: suricata alerts rate
items.description: detection alerts per second

triggers.name: suricata alert rate above weekly baseline on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: baselinedev(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[suricata_alerts.rate],1h:now/h,"d",10)>3 and last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[suricata_alerts.rate])>1
triggers.description: Seasonal baseline deviation with a 1/s absolute floor. Imported at Information severity; promoted only after 14 days of reviewed-quiet trend rows.

triggers.name: suricata alert rate above static ceiling on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Placeholder ceiling; value retuned from phase 5 shadow data (tasks.md 5.4). Backstop for slow ramps the baseline family cannot catch.

items.name: suricata kernel drop rate
items.description: capture-ring drops per second (rate twin of the cumulative counter, fixing the raw-cumulative plot)

items.name: responder alerts seen
items.description: cumulative EVE alerts the responder has consumed

items.name: responder blocks issued
items.description: cumulative blocks the responder has written to the maps

items.name: responder dry-run would-block
items.description: cumulative blocks the responder would have issued while in dry-run

items.name: responder last alert time
items.description: epoch of the last alert the responder consumed

items.name: responder last action time
items.description: epoch of the responder's last block or dry-run decision

items.name: attacker geography summary
items.description: top attacker countries and hit counts (nodeguard-geo), e.g. NL:272 US:131; empty until the geoip index is installed

items.name: attacker sources hitting
items.description: distinct blocked sources that have dropped a packet

items.name: attacker sources geolocated
items.description: of the hitting sources, how many resolved to a country

items.name: attacker countries
items.description: distinct countries among the geolocated attacker sources

items.name: nodeguard blocks v4
items.description: live v4 block-map entries, from the sweep cache

items.name: nodeguard blocks v6
items.description: live v6 block-map entries, from the sweep cache

items.name: nodeguard v4 block map utilization
items.description: v4 block-map fill percentage; denominator read from the installed map spec

triggers.name: nodeguard v4 block map over 85 percent full on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Static ceiling; the backstop the trend projection cannot provide.

triggers.name: nodeguard v4 block map projected full within 24h on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: timeleft(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[util_v4_pct],7d,90)<86400 and timeleft(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[util_v4_pct],7d,90)<>-1
triggers.description: 7-day trend projects 90 percent within 24h; the <>-1 guard suppresses the no-projection case.

items.name: nodeguard v6 block map utilization
items.description: v6 block-map fill percentage; denominator read from the installed map spec

triggers.name: nodeguard v6 block map over 85 percent full on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Static ceiling; the backstop the trend projection cannot provide.

triggers.name: nodeguard v6 block map projected full within 24h on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: timeleft(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[util_v6_pct],7d,90)<86400 and timeleft(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[util_v6_pct],7d,90)<>-1
triggers.description: 7-day trend projects 90 percent within 24h; the <>-1 guard suppresses the no-projection case.

items.name: nodeguard sweep age
items.description: seconds since the sweep last wrote the map statistics cache

triggers.name: nodeguard sweep cache stale on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Three sweep periods without a cache write; map counts are aging. Age is first-class so 0 scanned can never read as 0 found.

items.name: nodeguard sweep walk duration
items.description: wall time of the sweep's full trie walk; trends make walk degradation visible before it hurts

items.name: nodeguard top blocked hits
items.description: hit count of the busiest blocked entry at the last sweep

triggers.name: nodeguard block-hit pressure above weekly baseline on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: baselinedev(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[top1_hits],1h:now/h,"d",10)>3 and last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[top1_hits])>1000
triggers.description: Seasonal baseline deviation with an absolute floor. Imported at Information severity; promoted only after 14 days of reviewed-quiet trend rows.

items.name: nodeguard top blocked sources
items.description: top-5 blocked sources ranked by hit DELTA since the previous sweep walk, cumulative carried as the secondary figure

items.name: nodeguard re-arm count
items.description: cumulative once-per-boot kill-switch auto re-arms, from config map slot 2

triggers.name: nodeguard kill switch auto re-arm occurred on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: The watchdog re-armed enforcement after a latch; review why the latch happened.

items.name: nodeguard program identity match
items.description: 1 = the live head program id equals /run/nodeguard/expected_prog_id; key omitted when the expected id is unknown, so the item goes unsupported instead of false-paging

triggers.name: nodeguard running program is not the installed one on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: The attached XDP program is not the one reload or attach installed; enforcement provenance unknown.

items.name: nodeguard attach mode
items.description: native, skb, or none, from xdp-loader status

items.name: nodeguard watchdog canary failures
items.description: consecutive canary failures at the last completed watchdog cycle (one-cycle lag; triggers use >= so the lag cannot mask a trip)

items.name: nodeguard watchdog lifeline failures
items.description: consecutive lifeline failures at the last completed watchdog cycle (one-cycle lag)

items.name: nodeguard watchdog tool failures
items.description: consecutive tooling failures at the last completed watchdog cycle (one-cycle lag)

items.name: nodeguard watchdog clean cycles
items.description: cumulative clean watchdog cycles; a stalled value with the timer active means the cycle is failing

items.name: nodeguard anomaly count
items.description: cumulative volumetric anomaly trips from the gateway-local EWMA detector

triggers.name: nodeguard volumetric anomaly detected on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: The gateway-local EWMA detector tripped: a per-cycle delta exceeded max(floor, mean + K * deviation) for the configured consecutive cycles.

items.name: nodeguard anomaly shadow count
items.description: cumulative shadow-mode trips (logged and exported, no alerting side effects); used to review the training window before promotion

items.name: nodeguard last anomaly time
items.description: epoch of the most recent anomaly trip

items.name: nodeguard sweep timer state
items.description: systemd is-active for nodeguard-sweep.timer (previously exported but untemplated)

triggers.name: nodeguard sweep timer is not active on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Belt-and-braces companion to the sweep_age trigger; the cache will age out while this is inactive.

discovery_rules.name: nodeguard feeds discovery
discovery_rules.description: Discovers configured feed names from the feeds_last_success_ts_* keys in the kv export (excluding the _min aggregate). Prototype keys are distinct from the static per-feed keys so discovery never collides with them during the parity window.

item_prototypes.name: feed {#FEED} last success
item_prototypes.description: epoch of {#FEED}'s last successful HTTP exchange (discovered)

trigger_prototypes.name: nodeguard feed {#FEED} stale (discovered) on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.expression: last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.feed.success_ts[{#FEED}])>0 and fuzzytime(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.feed.success_ts[{#FEED}],46800)=0 and nodata(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.feed.success_ts[{#FEED}],2h)=0
trigger_prototypes.description: Two full cycles plus margin without a successful exchange. Information severity during the parity window; the nodata guard silences a feed removed from feeds.conf once discovery drops it.

trigger_prototypes.name: nodeguard feed {#FEED} failed open (discovered) on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.expression: last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.feed.success_ts[{#FEED}])>0 and fuzzytime(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.feed.success_ts[{#FEED}],93600)=0 and nodata(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.feed.success_ts[{#FEED}],2h)=0
trigger_prototypes.description: Entries for this feed have expired in-kernel; designed decay, not an outage. Information severity during the parity window; nodata-guarded.

trigger_prototypes.name: nodeguard feed {#FEED} upstream frozen (discovered) on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.expression: last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.feed.age[{#FEED}])>604800 and nodata(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.feed.age[{#FEED}],2h)=0
trigger_prototypes.description: Upstream unchanged for 7 days. Information severity during the parity window; nodata-guarded.

triggers.name: nodeguard stats unreadable on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[stats_read_fail])=1 or nodata(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[pass],10m)=1
triggers.description: stats_read_fail=1 or the counters are unsupported; XDP counters are unknown, not zero.

triggers.name: suricata alive but counters unreadable on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: nodata(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[kernel_drops],10m)=1 and last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[suricata])="active"
triggers.description: Live unit, dead socket: suricata reports active but kernel_drops is unsupported, which ng.suricata alone cannot catch.

triggers.name: nodeguard attached in degraded mode on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[attach_mode])<>"native" and last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[attach_state])="attached"
triggers.description: Attached but not in native driver mode; enforcement works with reduced performance headroom.

triggers.name: nodeguard watchdog approaching trip on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[wd_canary_fail])>=2 or last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[wd_lifeline_fail])>=2
triggers.description: Two consecutive canary or lifeline failures; fires before the watchdog's soft-off trip. >= comparisons so the one-cycle export lag cannot mask a trip.

triggers.name: nodeguard responder dry-run divergence on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.expression: (last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[resp_dryrun_would_block])-last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[resp_dryrun_would_block],#10))>0 and (last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[resp_blocks_issued])-last(/Nodeguard by Zabbix agent/nodeguard.kv[resp_blocks_issued],#10))=0
triggers.description: Dry-run would-block is rising while issued blocks are flat: the responder wants to act and is configured not to.
